coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Fourteen attacks run, none landed. Custody is clean and the MF-6 is unapplied: b119f983 at 0444 unmoved, HEAD never left 6516d8c, file 08 still at 24 gate rows with no DR-G25, COORD at its pin, and all four file pins plus the D-150 commit pin reproducing. I verified the predecessor first, since this act builds on a file 08 that D-150 rewrote: the applied DR-G24 row and condition-4 cell are byte-identical to the blocks D-150 consented to, condition 4 is still MET, and the 65 non-gate rows and the 4-of-32 figure are untouched. The mechanics are the tightest instance of this template so far. The before operand is byte-exact against the live cell and occurs exactly once in the whole file, both operands are fenced with no backslash bytes and no edge whitespace, and a character-by-character diff shows exactly five changes — 24 to 25 owners, 20 to 21 required gates, the D-151 attribution, the G25-named clause, and 21 to 22 OPEN — with the G03/G04, G17, G23 and G24 clauses and the HARD-BLOCKED count untouched. Those figures reconcile against a table I counted myself at 24 rows, 21 OPEN and 3 HARD-BLOCKED. The new row carries eight fields in the header's order with status OPEN and a harness cell built like the G23 and G24 rows, DR-G25 is a free identifier, the insertion anchor is real, and Limb B names the identifier in the same act so condition 4 holds at 21 of 21. Fidelity to the recorded artifact holds: the owner string and the NT-3-only ownership match exactly, the row's claim is the artifact's first two claim sentences with the distinguishing third sentence moved into the Why section rather than dropped, and the retained-evidence column carries all three elements of NT-3's contract pass condition. Decision 6 accounts for all eight classes — NT-1 and NT-2 at G24, NT-3 here, NT-4 discharged, NT-5 through NT-8 leftover — and gives four leftover as the reason gates 2 and 3 fail, with gate 4 reserving the determination. One method note: a plain substring search suggested the D-002 set refusal was missing, which was an artifact of the blockquote marker falling inside the wrapped phrase. Re-checking with the markers stripped shows every refusal present. That is the second false negative of this kind I have caught in my own checking this session, and it is the error class I would charge in a subject.
